Sort and index a BAM file

Source: R/bam_processing.R
HORIZON_sort_index_bam.Rd

Coordinate-sorts the BAM produced by HORIZON_run_align and creates a BAI index file. Sorting is required before feature counting.

Usage

HORIZON_sort_index_bam(
  sample_sheet,
  sample_id,
  threads = 4,
  memory_per_thread = 2000,
  remove_unsorted = TRUE
)

Arguments

sample_sheet

Validated sample sheet data.frame from HORIZON_validate_sample_sheet.

sample_id

Character. Sample ID to process.

threads

Integer. Number of sort threads. Default 4.

memory_per_thread

Integer. Memory per sort thread in MB. Total RAM used is approximately memory_per_thread * threads MB. Default 2000.

remove_unsorted

Logical. Delete the unsorted BAM after sorting to free disk space. Default TRUE.

Value

Character. Path to the sorted, indexed BAM file, invisibly.

Details

By default, the unsorted BAM is deleted after sorting to avoid doubling disk usage (set remove_unsorted = FALSE to keep it).

RAM note: total RAM used during sorting is approximately memory_per_thread * threads MB. Reduce threads or memory_per_thread on memory-constrained machines.
